---
title: Link Button
description: Style a link as a button.
---

Use the link button component to style a link as a button.

```markdown
<LinkButton url='/components/ui/link-button'>
  My Link Button
</LinkButton>
```

## Options

| Prop | Description | Options | Default |
|------|-------------|---------|---------|
| `url` _(required)_ | Renders a button that, when clicked, navigates to the specified URL. It can accept either a full external link (e.g. `https://google.com`) or link to another page within your evidence app (e.g. `/sales/performance`). | string |  |
